subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the novel 'The Insider'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Narasimha Rao**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Insider is an account of the political scenario of India during the time of former Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao, who is the author of the book.
 
• Pamulaparthi Venkata Narasimha Rao (28 June 1921 – 23 December 2004) was an Indian lawyer and politician who served as the 9th Prime Minister of India from 1991 to 1996.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Father of Indian Economic Reforms".
 
• Rao was also referred to as Chanakya for his ability to steer economic and political legislation through the parliament at a time when he headed a minority government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed__**: was the **5th president of India (1974-77)**. He was the **second Muslim president** of India and also the **second president **of India to **die **in office.
